Container.Name: reelsaw
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted, AI-powered video clipper: paste a YouTube link or upload a video and Reelsaw transcribes it, asks a language model for the most clippable moments, reframes the speaker into vertical 9:16 with face tracking, cuts verified fillers and false starts, burns in word-highlight captions and renders the clips. Open source (AGPL-3.0). Every model is yours to choose: fully local with Ollama and a local Whisper, or OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Groq, Deepgram, AssemblyAI. Also an MCP server, so agents can drive it.
Needs a PostgreSQL 15+ database (any Postgres container on this server; set DATABASE_URL). For the language model, point AI_MODEL at an Ollama container on this server (compat:qwen2.5:14b with OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL=http://<unraid-ip>:11434/v1) or at a cloud provider with its key. For transcription use a cloud model (openai:whisper-1, deepgram:nova-3, groq:whisper-large-v3-turbo) or a Speaches container through OPENAI_BASE_URL. The first account to sign up becomes the admin; set SIGNUP_MODE to approval or closed afterwards. Full reference: https://github.com/osbytes/reelsaw/blob/main/docs/CONFIG.md
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL container (DATABASE_URL) and either an Ollama container or a cloud model key.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Container port 3000

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Uploads, rendered clips, scratch files, logs

Config.Name: APP_URL
Config.Description: The URL you open in the browser (used for cookies, CORS and links in emails). Change the IP to this server's.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL 15+ connection string: a database and user you created on a Postgres container on this server.

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: 32+ random characters (openssl rand -base64 32). Signs sessions and encrypts provider keys entered in Settings; do not change it later.

Config.Name: AI_MODEL
Config.Description: Language model as provider:model. compat:<model> for Ollama (with OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL), or openai:gpt-4o-mini, anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5, google:gemini-2.5-flash, groq:llama-3.3-70b-versatile with the matching key. Admins can change it later in Settings.

Config.Name: OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Your Ollama container's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (used by compat: models). Pull the model there first: ollama pull qwen2.5:14b

Config.Name: OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY
Config.Description: Key for the compat: server. Ollama accepts any value.

Config.Name: TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL
Config.Description: Speech-to-text as provider:model; it must return word timestamps: openai:whisper-1, deepgram:nova-3, assemblyai:best, groq:whisper-large-v3-turbo, or openai:Systran/faster-whisper-small with OPENAI_BASE_URL pointing at a Speaches container.

Config.Name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Only for a local Speaches (faster-whisper) container, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000/v1. Leave empty for OpenAI's cloud.

Config.Name: OPENAI_API_KEY
Config.Description: OpenAI key for openai: models (any value, e.g. local, when OPENAI_BASE_URL points at Speaches).

Config.Name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Config.Description: For anthropic: models.

Config.Name: GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY
Config.Description: For google: models.

Config.Name: GROQ_API_KEY
Config.Description: For groq: models.

Config.Name: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
Config.Description: For deepgram: transcription.

Config.Name: SIGNUP_MODE
Config.Description: open: anyone may sign up (do this first, the first account becomes the admin). approval: new accounts wait for an admin. closed: no sign-ups. Also changeable in Settings.

Config.Name: MAX_UPLOAD_MB
Config.Description: Largest accepted upload in MB.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: true only when a reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG) sits in front and sets X-Forwarded-For.

Config.Name: DATA_DIR
Config.Description: Working directory inside the container (the Data path above).

Config.Name: LOG_FILE
Config.Description: JSON log files, daily, 7 kept; issue reports include them.
